says: Scene 3, and this time the figure is big enough to read: a scout in profile, from the waist up, goggles pushed onto her forehead, cropped hair, a wrapped scarf, banded shoulder armour, a chest strap with buckles and a gloved fist, standing in front of the skiff she has landed. Behind her: a thin-spired city on the horizon and the banded edge of a giant planet cropped by the corner. One light from the upper right. Fine point for the distance, sharpened again for her; continuous fine lines broken only by light, no dashes; solid darks only in the deepest shadows.
